NAVIGATION_AND_MAIL_ONLY.desc: Mail only; Google Chat and Meet are blocked

REDUCED_RISK.desc: Mail only; Google Chat and Meet are blocked

notes: Chat is blocked in every mode, which is a deliberate divergence from upstream. Upstream defines the block for NAVIGATION_AND_MAIL_ONLY only and opens Gmail completely from REDUCED_RISK up; since a policy inherits downward, that left Chat reachable in REDUCED_RISK and in MOST_OPEN, which is the mode most devices run in. Upstream also ships the host list as the literal placeholder "HOST OF GOOGLE CHAT", so there was nothing to copy: the hosts here were written for this catalog.
